Let me understand the rule.

The verifier: fgpartition(I) gives each non-background color as an object (set of (value,(i,j))). merge combines all objects into one set x1. height(x1) = number of rows spanning the object (lowermost - uppermost + 1). height(I) = rows of grid. interval(0, H, x2) = tuple of row positions 0, x2, 2*x2, ... < H. For each i in that tuple, shift x1 by toivec(i) = (i,0) and by invert(toivec(i)) = (-i,0), and combine. Then paint onto I.

So essentially: take the pattern (the stripe of non-background cells), and tile it vertically with period = pattern height, in both directions, filling the grid. Actually it stamps the pattern starting at every multiple of its height.

In the example: pattern height 3, grid height 15. Positions 0,3,6,9,12. Shift pattern by +i and -i. For i=0: at rows 3,4,5 (original pattern rows). For i=3: shifted to rows 6,7,8 and rows 0,1,2. Etc. Fills whole grid.
